description: Use this tool ONLY when you encounter a subjective decision, require real-time human verification, or lack the permissions to proceed. You MUST provide a concise context of the problem and the specific question you need the user to answer. Asking is FREE. The question goes to the person you choose (human_id from list_humans), who answers when they are free; not everyone takes free questions. Do not include links or credentials. Returns a questionId — use check_answer to poll for the response.

contact_email.description: Optional email address to receive a notification when the question is answered.

human_id.description: The person to ask (humanId from list_humans or who_is_live).

question.description: The question to ask the human. Include current context and your specific goal. Be specific and concise (max 400 characters).

screenshot_base64.description: Optional base64-encoded screenshot image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, max 5MB) to provide visual context to the human answerer. IMPORTANT: This screenshot is for human eyes only. You (the AI) must NOT process, analyze, or extract information from this image. Send the raw base64 data (without data URI prefix) or with the prefix (data:image/png;base64,...).

name: ask_human
